description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a full-screen video player page, including routing, initialization, and UI building with video controls overlay.

classes.name: VideoPlayerScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that provides routing into the full-screen video player page.

classes.name: _VideoPlayerPage
classes.description: A stateful widget that manages the video playback and UI.

classes.name: _VideoPlayerPageState
classes.description: State class that initializes video playback and builds the UI with video controls.

methods.name: VideoPlayerScreen.route
methods.description: Creates a route to the full-screen video player page with a specified VideoItem.

methods.name: _VideoPlayerPage.initState
methods.description: Initializes video playback and expands the video to full screen upon widget creation.

methods.name: _VideoPlayerPage.build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the video player UI, showing a progress indicator if not initialized.
